name: SpaceX Starlink Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls SpaceX/Starlink ephemeris over HTTP on a timer, parses + validates, stores records, and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic Starlink ephemeris pull (default every 6h, matching SpaceX's few-times-daily MEME regeneration; per-pull object cap bounds burst load).

methods.description: Fetches SpaceX/Starlink ephemeris over HTTP, parses + validates, stores the records, signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: PNM pointers published for each pulled + stored ephemeris batch.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull batch.

methods.displayName: Fetch + parse operator ephemeris and emit $OEM (OD-flow guest-link)
methods.description: Fetches every selected operator ephemeris as a complete file through bounded parallel host HTTP calls, parses to SDS $OEM in-memory, and emits one bounded page of $OEM aligned-binary frames per invocation until the full catalog is drained. Nothing stored/signed/published.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional node CONFIG (endpoints/target/objectCap); default provider endpoints otherwise.
SDS $OEM ephemeris (aligned-binary), one per operator object. Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.
